title: PAB Replication Kit v1.0: Preregistration Template, Deterministic Harness Skeleton, and Protocol Rules for Running Preregistered Adversarial Batteries Against Any System
description:
Replication kit for the Preregistered Adversarial Batteries (PAB) protocol (methodology: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23422632). Enables any operator to run the protocol against their own system: (1) the preregistration template — falsifier table with predicted verdicts, committed before any run; (2) the deterministic harness skeleton — reference implementations of the six gate patterns (checksum/pin verification, exact-match allowlists, parity recomputation, identity-hash binding, cross-source parity, expected-count guards) plus the critical-hold gate where a refusal counts as a pass; (3) the protocol rules — seven stages, scoring criteria, hold-by-design adjudication, receipt format, and the append-only ledger discipline.

Non-adaptable rules: no language model in the decision path; all injections synthetic; critical-severity events predict a fail-closed hold; misses are published as misses. The comparability contract is the frozen falsifier definition (attack class + predicted verdict), not the implementation. Published so third parties can replicate even one battery on an independent system with independent adjudication — converting the protocol from a claim into a method.

This kit and its methodology are provided for educational and research purposes only. They are not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments.
